prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit.
One final targeted revision of the Biluo dialogue portrait. Input 1 is the v1 PORTRAIT EDIT TARGET. Input 2 is her full-body identity master. Inputs 3–5 are approved Mara/Leiya/Tore style references only. Output exactly ONE transparent head portrait with a 74×100 logical pixel composition.
Keep Biluo recognizable: woman in her THIRTIES, long straight substantial nose, WIDE cheekbones and diamond angular jaw, warm light skin, swept-back brown wavy hair tied low behind the visible ear, burgundy tie, wine-red travel garment and gray wool shawl. Keep the complete ear/hair crown/low tail silhouette. Do not turn her into any style reference character.
Apply this specific correction set:
1. SHORTEN THE EXPOSED NECK BY ONE QUARTER. Raise the narrow collar line and enlarge the FACE modestly relative to the hairstyle. The face is the central visual mass; no bust, chest, big shoulders or long bare neck. Only a short neck support and tiny gray/burgundy garment strip at bottom.
2. Make EYES SMALL, DARK AND NARROW. Reduce the visible eye opening and especially both white patches drastically: sclera should be tiny dark WARM GRAY/TAN slivers, no brighter than skin midtone, about one logical pixel high. NO white, pale cream, gloss, large iris or doll eyes. Preserve her wide eye spacing and long nose.
3. Replace both upward-inner worried eyebrows with nearly level brows and ONLY ONE small questioning lift. Calm candid conversational explanation, faint friendly warmth. A short barely PARTED mouth with no teeth, fuller lower lip, not sad, pleading, stern or teenage.
Preserve the existing identity, angle, skin tone and garment colors. Organize skin into broad connected forehead/nose/cheek/jaw planes; simplify hair highlights into three or four large connected masses rather than many thin repeated strands. Coarse crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, ≤32 flat earthy colors, no blur, antialiasing, gradients, dithering or texture noise.
Very important: the generated raw canvas itself must contain the FULL crown, ears, back hair and tail with 2–3 logical pixels clear transparent margin on all outer top/side edges. No canvas-edge clipping and no patching with extra padding. Genuinely transparent background. No text, frame, watermark, props or scene.
